<thought>We need the number of aromatic carbons in the molecule, but no SMILES or structure is directly provided. The available tools can give NMR spectra for the sample at hand, which should include signals for aromatic carbons. By retrieving the 13C NMR spectrum and counting the peaks in the typical aromatic carbon chemical shift range (≈110–160 ppm), we can determine the aromatic carbon count.</thought>
